title: Reactive vs Proactive
summary: Reduce repetitive Reactive work with AI to open space for Proactive work

sections.heading: Orientation — What Will You Understand?
sections.subtitle: What Will You Understand?
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What you will understand:** Repetitive work that waits for your response every day eats up your thinking time — and AI (artificial intelligence) can reduce some of it.
- **Why now?** In the previous lesson you identified a recurring decision. Today you will understand why the same decisions come back every week and keep you in "firefighting" mode.
- **After this lesson:** You will list 5 weekly tasks, label each one **Reactive** or **Proactive**, and pick one Reactive task that AI can help reduce.

sections.heading: Tension — A Familiar Situation
sections.subtitle: A Familiar Situation
sections.contentMarkdown:
You close your day feeling like you "worked" — but nothing was built.

A business owner opens WhatsApp in the morning — a supplier, a customer, an employee, a complaint. By 3 PM they are still replying. No time for pricing. No time for planning.

This is **Reactive mode**: the world decides your day — not you. It is not laziness. It is repeated work that was never organized.

AI does not solve every problem. But it helps with repetitive tasks: summarizing, drafting a reply, sorting priorities — to free up even half an hour of **Proactive** time each week.

sections.heading: Core Idea — Reduce the Repetitive, Open the Door to Proactive
sections.subtitle: Reduce the Repetitive, Open the Door to Proactive
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Reduce the repetitive — open the door to Proactive work**

- **Reactive:** Work that comes to you — a message, a problem, an urgent request. It must get done, but it does not build your business on its own.
- **Proactive:** Work you choose — pricing, a new offer, following up with an important customer, improving a process. This is what moves your business forward.
- If 90% of your week is Reactive, you will never get to building systems. The goal is not zero Reactive — the goal is to reduce the repetitive parts with AI so that Proactive work becomes possible.
- Ask yourself: "What task do I do every week in exactly the same way?" — that is your first candidate for AI.

sections.heading: Glossary — Two Terms for Classification
sections.subtitle: Two Terms for Classification
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|------|---------|--------|
| **Reactive** | A task that comes from outside — you must respond or act right away | Customer complaint, supplier message, urgent request from an employee |
| **Proactive** | A task you plan before it becomes a crisis | Reviewing the week's numbers, updating a price list, designing a customer follow-up process |

sections.heading: Quiz — Quick Check
sections.subtitle: Quick Check
sections.contentMarkdown: Karim opened WhatsApp first thing in the morning because of a major supplier problem and spent 3 hours on it. How would you classify this?

quiz.question: Karim opened WhatsApp first thing in the morning because of a major supplier problem and spent 3 hours on it. How would you classify this?
options: Proactive — he chose to prioritize the supplier issue himself.
Reactive — the situation decided his day before he could choose his own priorities.
Neither — it depends on how serious the problem was.
Proactive — because he solved the problem successfully.
quiz.explanation: The size of the problem is not the measure. The measure is: who decided what you worked on first? If the outside world pulled you in before you set your own priorities, that is Reactive. Reducing repetitive Reactive work starts with recognizing when the world is taking your day.

sections.heading: Mission — Your Task
sections.subtitle: Your Task
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** This mission is practical — not motivational. List 5 tasks you do every week (or nearly every week) and label each one Reactive or Proactive. Then pick one Reactive task that AI could help reduce. Full automation is not required — honest diagnosis is.

**Delivery:** Your 5 tasks + their labels + the one Reactive task you chose + how AI could help (one or two sentences).

**Rubric:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| Realistic classification | 60% | 5 tasks from your real week — each one labeled |
| AI selection | 40% | One Reactive task with a specific idea for how AI helps |
